methodologyNotes: Covers full-size corded upright vacuum cleaners sold at a published US price. Excludes cordless stick vacuums, canister vacuums, robot vacuums, carpet shampooers, and wet/dry shop vacs. Price is typical US MSRP/street in USD. configuration is an enum, 'bagged' or 'bagless'. filtrationType is an enum: 'sealed-HEPA' (fully sealed system with HEPA media), 'HEPA' (HEPA media, not fully sealed), or 'standard' (non-HEPA media). cleaningPathWidthIn is the floor-nozzle cleaning path width in inches. dirtCapacityLiters is usable dust-cup volume for bagless models or nominal bag volume for bagged models, in liters. cordLengthFt is power-cord length in feet. inputPowerWatts is rated motor input power in watts; null if the maker publishes only amperage. weightLbs is unit weight in pounds. heightAdjustment is an enum: 'automatic', 'manual', or 'none'. liftAway is a boolean: true if the nozzle/canister detaches into a portable pod for above-floor cleaning. swivelSteering is a boolean for articulating swivel steering. warrantyYears is the manufacturer limited warranty in years. Any spec not disclosed by the manufacturer is null.
